chain.description: Restrict to one chain, e.g. Base, BNB Chain, Gnosis. Venue-level rows have no chain.

detail.description: 'full' returns every venue, chain and stage row even with no filter. Omitted with no venue/chain/include_platforms, the answer is the compact per-venue summary, each line with the call for its full detail.

include_platforms.description: Include the per-platform breakdown of who produced the registrations (agentURI attribution). Default false — it roughly doubles the response.

response_format.description: Text format; structuredContent is JSON either way.

venue.description: Restrict to one venue: erc8004, olas, virtuals, x402, erc4337_accounts, key_management, singularitynet, morpheus.
